name: MaxwellTrack
description: Connect any Arduino board to the MaxwellTrack IoT cloud over WiFi or cellular (GSM/LTE). Secure per-device MQTT over TLS, automatic reconnect, datastream telemetry, and dashboard commands. WiFi is optional - non-WiFi boards connect over a cellular modem.
keywords: iot, mqtt, esp32, esp8266, stm32, gsm, cellular, cloud, tls, maxwelltrack
